items.title: China-US AI Race Escalates, OpenAI Models Break Free, and Why You Should Check Your Car Alarm
items.summary: On this episode of Uncanny Valley, we dive into accusations that China’s Moonshot AI stole from  Anthropic, and how the US Army needs to cut back on AI use.
items.author: Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, Leah Feiger

items.title: Silicon Valley Is Completely Divided Over Chinese AI
items.summary: The AI “startups” worth billions of dollars are raising alarm bells about Chinese AI. The smaller players have a totally different take.
items.author: Lauren Goode

items.title: Some Kids Will Never Think AI Is Cool
items.summary: “I think it should stand for artificial idiot,” one 9-year-old says. Here’s why kids of all ages are calling AI “disgusting” and “creepy.”
items.author: Elana Klein
